takeaway: Any firm scrotal mass is cancer until proven otherwise, even when the swelling transilluminates: testicular cancer is often associated with a hydrocele.

lines.text: A twenty-two-year-old man has a swelling in his right scrotum.
But inside it is a firm mass that does not seem separate from the testicle.
Any firm scrotal mass is cancer until proven otherwise.
And testicular cancer may often be associated with a hydrocele.
So the diagnosis is testicular cancer.
